title: Frontend System Design Interviews
summary: Learn frontend architecture decisions, then rehearse six public candidate-reported design topics with diagrams, guided whiteboard exercises, and a shared rubric.
audience: Frontend engineers preparing for collaborative system design interviews without coding.

units.title: Frontend System Design Interview Guide
units.summary: Review component architecture, data flow, APIs, caching, rendering, and three illustrated examples.

units.title: Run and Review a Rehearsal
units.summary: Set up the whiteboard, distinguish reported evidence from adaptations, and use the shared rubric.

units.title: Amazon — Picture-and-Word Learning Game
units.summary: Design a mobile-first picture-and-word learning app with answer feedback and session progress.

units.title: Atlassian — Collaborative Kanban Board
units.summary: Design a board where users create cards, move them between columns, and see teammates’ changes.

units.title: Wayfair — Shopping Application
units.summary: Design a storefront with product discovery, reviews, and a persistent cart.

units.title: Adobe — Browser File Manager
units.summary: Design a file manager with folder navigation, search, rename, move, and upload.

units.title: Salesforce — WhatsApp-Style Web Messaging
units.summary: Design a messaging client with conversation history, sending, delivery status, and reconnect recovery.

units.title: Uber — Calendar Application
units.summary: Design a calendar with month/week views, event creation, editing, and recurring meetings.
